intro.text: A Stoneward who helps Shallan raid a Ghostblood hideout.

items.text: Ordered to help Shallan raid a Ghostblood hideout, Erinor spoke to the stones and sensed a secret exit leading down into the chasms. While they were exploring it, the signal came, and he melted the ceiling so the Windrunners could get into the basement and capture the Ghostbloods.
